examples.en: He was overruled by the owner, Peter Bolton, who insisted on Cool Ground running in the Gold Cup.
examples.zh: 他的意见被坚持让酷地参加金杯赛的主人彼得•博尔顿否决了。

examples.en: Mr Bolton himself was said to have been keen.
examples.zh: 据说博尔顿先生自己也期望如此。

examples.en: It is either very good or very bad with Bolton.
examples.zh: 目前的博尔顿队既说不上太好也说不上太坏。
